cards.card_text: She says, “The LORD has seen my affliction.”
cards.verse_text: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction.
cards.snippet: …she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction.

cards.card_text: But God has seen his affliction and the toil of his hands, Jacob says.
cards.verse_text: But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.”
cards.snippet: But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.”

cards.card_text: When Joseph names his second son Ephraim, he says God has made him fruitful in the land of his affliction.
cards.verse_text: And the second son he named Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
cards.snippet: …Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

cards.card_text: Then the LORD tells him He has seen the affliction of His people in Egypt, He has heard them crying out, and He's aware of their sufferings.
cards.verse_text: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt.
cards.snippet: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt.

cards.card_text: Moses is to assemble the elders of Israel and tell them the LORD has appeared to him and promised to bring them up out of their affliction in Egypt.
cards.verse_text: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
cards.snippet: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites,…

cards.card_text: affliction offerings faithfulness
cards.verse_text: And when they heard that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.
cards.snippet: …that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.

cards.card_text: No leavened bread with the Passover, and for seven days it's unleavened bread, what Moses calls the bread of affliction.
cards.verse_text: You must not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt.
cards.snippet: …days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may…

cards.card_text: He hears their voice and sees their affliction He softens the hearts of the Egyptians He gives them rest in the land of Goshen
cards.verse_text: So we called out to the LORD, the God of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.
cards.snippet: …of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.

cards.card_text: Many troubles and afflictions will come on them.
cards.verse_text: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them.
cards.snippet: …from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them.

cards.card_text: She asks Him to look on her affliction, remember her and give her a son.
cards.verse_text: And she made a vow, saying, “O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, not forgetting Your maidservant but giving her a son, then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall ever touch his head.”
cards.snippet: …saying, “O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, not forgetting Your maidservant but giving…

cards.card_text: But then Samuel says that today, Israel has ___ their God, who saves them from all their troubles and afflictions.
cards.verse_text: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
cards.snippet: …have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’…

cards.card_text: With the curses still coming, David hopes the LORD will see his affliction and repay him with ___ for the cursing he receives that day.
cards.verse_text: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”
cards.snippet: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”

cards.card_text: Whatever the trouble, each one knows his own afflictions and spreads out his hands toward the temple.
cards.verse_text: then may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
cards.snippet: …may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—

cards.card_text: Then the prayer moves to Egypt, where God saw the affliction of Israel's fathers and heard their cry at the Red Sea.
cards.verse_text: You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red Sea.
cards.snippet: You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red…

cards.card_text: But say people end up bound in chains, caught in cords of affliction.
cards.verse_text: And if men are bound with chains, caught in cords of affliction, then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.
cards.snippet: And if men are bound with chains, caught in cords of affliction, then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.

cards.card_text: Through their affliction Before any trouble comes By sending a messenger
cards.verse_text: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.
cards.snippet: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.

cards.card_text: Elihu warns Job to be careful not to turn to ___, and he says Job has preferred it to affliction.
cards.verse_text: Be careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.
cards.snippet: …careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.

cards.card_text: David asks to be freed from his distress, and for the LORD to consider his affliction and trouble.
cards.verse_text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
cards.snippet: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

cards.card_text: Along with considering his affliction and trouble, David asks the LORD to take away all his ___.
cards.verse_text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
cards.snippet: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

cards.card_text: David will rejoice because the LORD has seen his ___ and known the anguish of his soul affliction victories riches
cards.verse_text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
cards.snippet: …glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

cards.card_text: David says the righteous won't face any afflictions at all.
cards.verse_text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
cards.snippet: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

cards.card_text: Many afflictions, yes, but David says the LORD delivers the righteous from them all.
cards.verse_text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
cards.snippet: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

cards.card_text: He asks why God forgets their affliction and oppression.
cards.verse_text: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
cards.snippet: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?

cards.card_text: Literally: these people sit in darkness and the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains.
cards.verse_text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
cards.snippet: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,

cards.card_text: It calls these folks fools, suffering affliction through their rebellious ways and their iniquities.
cards.verse_text: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
cards.snippet: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.

cards.card_text: But the LORD lifts the ___ from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
cards.verse_text: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
cards.snippet: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.

cards.card_text: The psalmist is in the middle of affliction.
cards.verse_text: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
cards.snippet: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

cards.card_text: He would have perished in his affliction He would have run away from his enemies He would have turned his back on God
cards.verse_text: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
cards.snippet: …had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

cards.card_text: He asks the LORD to look upon his affliction and rescue him.
cards.verse_text: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
cards.snippet: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.

cards.card_text: The Teacher calls this a grievous affliction too: "Exactly as a man is born, so he will depart."
cards.verse_text: This too is a grievous affliction: Exactly as a man is born, so he will depart.
cards.snippet: This too is a grievous affliction: Exactly as a man is born, so he will depart.

cards.card_text: True or false: the Teacher calls this situation futile and a grievous affliction.
cards.verse_text: This is futile and a grievous affliction.
cards.snippet: This is futile and a grievous affliction.

cards.card_text: But hard times will still come: the Lord will give them the bread of adversity and the water of affliction.
cards.verse_text: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you will see Him.
cards.snippet: …Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you…

cards.card_text: In the furnace of affliction In the depths of the sea In the belly of the fish
cards.verse_text: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
cards.snippet: …but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

cards.card_text: Judah, Jerusalem's kingdom, has gone into exile, under affliction and harsh slavery.
cards.verse_text: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest.
cards.snippet: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place…

cards.card_text: Then the poem cries out, asking someone to look on "my affliction." Who?
cards.verse_text: Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
cards.snippet: Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!

cards.card_text: He doesn't give his name, but his first words are, "I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath."
cards.verse_text: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
cards.snippet: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.

cards.card_text: Then he says, "Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall." The wormwood shows up again, and I think that bitterness is still with him.
cards.verse_text: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
cards.snippet: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.

cards.card_text: He says that in their affliction, they will earnestly seek Him.
cards.verse_text: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.” Come, let us return to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.” Come, let us return to the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then Nahum talks about affliction.
cards.verse_text: Affliction will not rise up a second time.
cards.snippet: Affliction will not rise up a second time.

cards.card_text: Then He tells her to go in peace and be free of her affliction.
cards.verse_text: Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
cards.snippet: Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”

cards.card_text: In town after town, the Holy Spirit warns Paul that chains and afflictions are waiting for him.
cards.verse_text: I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
cards.snippet: …in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.

cards.card_text: Then Paul calls their troubles 'light and momentary affliction.'
cards.verse_text: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
cards.snippet: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far…

cards.card_text: What does Paul say this light and momentary affliction is producing for them?
cards.verse_text: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
cards.snippet: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far…

cards.card_text: affliction honors victory
cards.verse_text: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
cards.snippet: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.

cards.card_text: Then Paul says, "I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions…" And he says who it's all for.
cards.verse_text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
cards.snippet: …fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

cards.card_text: Persecution and affliction A long famine in the land Quarrels inside the church
cards.verse_text: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
cards.snippet: …your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.

cards.card_text: He says "it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you," and that's only half of it.
cards.verse_text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
cards.snippet: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

cards.card_text: Then James gives the brothers an example of patience in affliction.
cards.verse_text: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
cards.snippet: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

cards.card_text: Who does James hold up to the brothers as an example of patience in affliction?
cards.verse_text: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
cards.snippet: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

cards.card_text: Jesus tells Smyrna He knows their affliction and their poverty.
cards.verse_text: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich!
cards.snippet: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich!
